mentions.name: Gardener communication app
mentions.description: This app helps the owner communicate with their gardener, supporting itemized task lists, quote requests, photo-based clarification, and basic scheduling and billing.
mentions.problem: The gardener's English is okay but there have been miscommunications.
mentions.source_excerpt:
an app to communicate with my gardener.

His English is okay but we've had miscommunications. We can itemize tasks, request quotes, delineate with photos, and do basic scheduling+billing.
